## Quick Start

### For New Contributors

1. Read the [Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
2. Find a [`good first issue`](https://github.com/glastor-dev/glastor-dev/labels/good%20first%20issue)
3. Comment on the issue to claim it
4. Fork, develop, and submit a Pull Request

### Ways to Contribute

- **Report bugs**: [Create issue](https://github.com/glastor-dev/glastor-dev/issues/new?template=bug_report.md)
- **Request features**: [Create issue](https://github.com/glastor-dev/glastor-dev/issues/new?template=feature_request.md)
- **Improve documentation**: Submit PR with edits
- **Submit code**: Follow workflow in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- **Review PRs**: Help review open pull requests

## Recognition

All contributors are:
- Listed in project README
- Credited in CHANGELOG for their changes
- Granted GitHub contributor status
